prBodyNotes: Release trains are decoupled: each subchart (`bjj-api`/`bjj-frontend`/`bjj-mongodb`) is versioned and published to GHCR OCI by release-please + publish-chart.yml.
This PR bumps the umbrella's dependency pin. It uses a `fix:` commit so release-please cuts a new **umbrella** release, which republishes the OCI umbrella chart that Flux consumes.
Requires the Renovate token to have `read:packages` on ghcr.io (charts are private).

packageRules.description: Internal BJJ Éire subcharts pinned in the umbrella. fix: => release-please bumps the umbrella and republishes to OCI.
